case.title: Two issues in one message (reminders + invoice)
case.subject: Reminders + invoice
case.text:
Hello,

Two things:

1) Since Monday our clients aren't getting their SMS reminders. A few people missed classes and said they never got a text. Nothing changed on our side as far as I know.

2) Also, our accountant needs the invoices for August and September with our company name (Lotus Yoga Studio Ltd) and VAT number on them. Where can I get those?

Thanks,
Priya
case.why: A good reply addresses both questions (reminders checklist + invoices/billing details). The KB hit should include at least one of the two articles.

output.reply:
Hello Priya,

Thanks for your message. Here is help with both points.

1) SMS reminders not sending
Please check these common causes:
- Message credits: SMS reminders use message credits, and when they run out reminders pause until you top up. Check your balance in Settings → Billing → Message credits. Since this started on a specific day, this is the most likely cause.
- Phone number format: numbers must include the country code (e.g. +44 7700 900000). Numbers without one are skipped.
- Client opt-out: if a client replied STOP, they won't receive further reminders. This shows on their profile.
- Booking timing: appointments booked inside the reminder window (e.g. 1 hour before with a 24-hour reminder) won't get that reminder.

You can see the status of each reminder (sent, failed, or skipped, and why) in Reports → Reminder log. Also check status.slotwise.test for any incidents. If credits are fine and the log shows reminders failing without a clear reason, reply with a couple of example client names and appointment times and we'll investigate further.

2) Invoices with company name and VAT number
All invoices are in Settings → Billing → Invoices, where you can click an invoice to download the PDF. To add your company name (Lotus Yoga Studio Ltd) and VAT number, edit Billing details. Please note that this only applies to future invoices. For corrected copies of past invoices (August and September), please reply with the invoice numbers and our billing team will help you with that.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support
